title: Octocode Awareness Configuration
description: Global shell-hook automation preferences stored at <OCTOCODE_HOME>/awareness.json; Pi native events are outside this contract.

hooks.description: Enable installed Awareness hooks. Missing configuration uses peer-communication defaults.

notifications.description: Allow hooks to deliver new peer messages.

verificationGate.description: Enable stop verification for tracked work with the guard/full profile.

sessionCapture.description: Enable automatic session handoffs with the full profile.

maintenanceReminders.description: Allow bounded maintenance-pressure reminders from hooks.
